title: Why The World's E-Waste Pile Keeps Growing
hook: Your dead phone joined a pile of 62 million tons of trash.
closing: One recycling bin at a time isn't going to cut it.
question: How many old phones do you own?

segments.say: In 2022 the world produced 62 million tons of electronic waste, up sharply since 2010.
Only 22 percent of e-waste was properly collected and recycled. The rest got dumped or burned.
Recycling meets just 1 percent of global rare earth demand -- we're throwing away a mine and digging a new one.
